name: jellytheatre
description: WebXR movie theatre client for Jellyfin

scripts.store-assets: vite build && node tools/screenshots/capture.mjs --store && node tools/screenshots/store-art.mjs
scripts.package:horizon: cd store/horizon && env -u ANDROID_SDK_ROOT npx -y @meta-quest/bubblewrap-cli@1.24.1 update --skipVersionUpgrade && env -u ANDROID_SDK_ROOT npx -y @meta-quest/bubblewrap-cli@1.24.1 build --skipPwaValidation
